data.name: Furough
data.gender_notes: Furough is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic word ‘faraha’ meaning ‘happiness’ and ‘ruh’ meaning ‘soul’. The name Furough signifies a soul that brings happiness like the gentle waves of the sea. The name Furough carries the meaning “Waves, Flow” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Furough usually hope their child will grow to embody waves, flow and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Furough belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Waves, Flow.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Furough total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
